title: The street lights
story:
The council has asked the pizzeria to fix the street lights on its delivery routes, and you're building them with code. Lamps stand on the ground, come in rings around roundabouts, switch on and off, and react by themselves when anything flips their On attribute. Drivers also want to know which lamp is closest to them, for reasons nobody will explain.

The checker builds lamps with your module using stand-ins for Roblox parts, vectors and attributes, so it runs right here.
create: A ModuleScript named `Builder` inside `Test11`, returning a table of functions.

requirements.text: It returns a table with `makeLamp`, `ringOfLamps`, `setLamp`, `watchLamp` and `nearestLamp`.

`makeLamp(position, parent)` creates and returns an anchored Part named `Lamp`, size 1 by 6 by 1, standing on `position` (so its centre is 3 studs above it), inside `parent`. It starts switched on: Neon material and an attribute `On` set to `true`.

`ringOfLamps(centre, radius, count, parent)` makes `count` lamps evenly spaced around a flat circle of that radius around `centre`, using `makeLamp`, and returns them in an array. A count of 0 returns an empty array.
`setLamp(lamp, on)` sets the `On` attribute, and makes the lamp look on (Neon, Transparency 0) or off (SmoothPlastic, Transparency 0.5).

`watchLamp(lamp)` connects to the lamp's `On` attribute changing, so changing the attribute anywhere updates the lamp's look by itself. It returns the connection, and disconnecting it stops the updates.
`nearestLamp(lamps, point)` returns the lamp from the array that's closest to `point`, or `nil` for an empty array.

hints: makeLamp is Instance.new plus properties, with Parent set last. The lamp's position is the point plus an offset of half its height.
For the ring, each lamp's angle is a full turn divided by count, times its index. Cos and sin of that angle, times the radius, give the X and Z offsets.
watchLamp connects to GetAttributeChangedSignal and calls setLamp with the new value. nearestLamp is a search loop that starts with math.huge.

static.fail: Create a ModuleScript named `Builder` inside the `Test11` folder.

check:
local Builder, loadInfo = Course.load("ServerScriptService.Course.Test11.Builder")
local problem = loadInfo.error
if type(Builder) ~= "table" then
	Course.fail("r2", "Builder should return a table of functions, but " .. (problem or ("it returned " .. Course.show(Builder))))
	for _, id in { "r3", "r4", "r5", "r6", "r7" } do
		Course.fail(id, "Not checked: Builder didn't load.")
	end
	return
end
for _, name in { "makeLamp", "ringOfLamps", "setLamp", "watchLamp", "nearestLamp" } do
	Course.check("r2", type(Builder[name]) == "function", "Builder." .. name .. " should be a function, but it's " .. Course.show(Builder[name]) .. ".")
end

local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
folder.Name = "Test11Check"
folder.Parent = workspace

local function isPart(value)
	return typeof(value) == "Instance" and value:IsA("BasePart")
end

Course.try("r3", function()
	local good, lamp = Course.call(Builder.makeLamp, Vector3.new(10, 0, 5), folder)
	if not good or not isPart(lamp) then
		Course.fail("r3", "makeLamp should return a Part, but " .. (if good then "returned " .. Course.show(lamp) else "errored: " .. tostring(lamp)))
		return
	end
	Course.check("r3", lamp.Name == "Lamp", "The lamp should be named \"Lamp\", but it's named " .. Course.show(lamp.Name))
	Course.check("r3", lamp.Parent == folder, "makeLamp should put the lamp inside the parent it's given.")
	Course.check("r3", lamp.Anchored == true, "The lamp should be anchored, or it falls over.")
	Course.check("r3", Course.near(lamp.Size, Vector3.new(1, 6, 1), 0.01), "The lamp's size should be 1, 6, 1, but it's " .. Course.show(lamp.Size))
	Course.check("r3", Course.near(lamp.Position, Vector3.new(10, 3, 5), 0.01), "makeLamp(Vector3.new(10, 0, 5), ...) should stand the lamp on that point, so its centre is at 10, 3, 5. It's at " .. Course.show(lamp.Position))
	Course.check("r3", lamp.Material == Enum.Material.Neon and lamp:GetAttribute("On") == true, "A new lamp starts switched on: Neon material and an attribute On set to true.")
end)

Course.try("r4", function()
	local good, lamps = Course.call(Builder.ringOfLamps, Vector3.new(40, 0, -20), 12, 6, folder)
	if not good or type(lamps) ~= "table" then
		Course.fail("r4", "ringOfLamps should return an array of lamps, but " .. (if good then "returned " .. Course.show(lamps) else "errored: " .. tostring(lamps)))
		return
	end
	Course.check("r4", #lamps == 6, "ringOfLamps(centre, 12, 6, parent) should return 6 lamps, but returned " .. #lamps)
	local nearestPair = math.huge
	for i, lamp in lamps do
		if not isPart(lamp) then
			Course.fail("r4", "Every item returned by ringOfLamps should be a lamp Part.")
			return
		end
		local flat = Vector3.new(lamp.Position.X - 40, 0, lamp.Position.Z + 20)
		Course.check("r4", math.abs(flat.Magnitude - 12) < 0.05, "Every lamp should be 12 studs from the centre along the ground, but one is " .. string.format("%.2f", flat.Magnitude) .. " studs away.")
		Course.check("r4", math.abs(lamp.Position.Y - 3) < 0.05, "Ring lamps should stand on the ground at the centre's height, like makeLamp's lamps.")
		for j = i + 1, #lamps do
			nearestPair = math.min(nearestPair, (lamp.Position - lamps[j].Position).Magnitude)
		end
	end
	Course.check("r4", math.abs(nearestPair - 12) < 0.05, "The lamps should be evenly spaced around the circle. For 6 lamps on a radius of 12, neighbours are exactly 12 studs apart, but the closest two are " .. string.format("%.2f", nearestPair) .. " apart.")
	local good2, none = Course.call(Builder.ringOfLamps, Vector3.zero, 5, 0, folder)
	Course.check("r4", good2 and type(none) == "table" and #none == 0, "ringOfLamps with a count of 0 should return an empty array.")
end)

Course.try("r5", function()
	local _, lamp = Course.call(Builder.makeLamp, Vector3.new(0, 0, 30), folder)
	if not isPart(lamp) then
		Course.fail("r5", "Not checked: makeLamp didn't return a Part.")
		return
	end
	local okOff = Course.call(Builder.setLamp, lamp, false)
	Course.check("r5", okOff and lamp:GetAttribute("On") == false and lamp.Material == Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic and math.abs(lamp.Transparency - 0.5) < 0.01,
		"setLamp(lamp, false) should set On to false, the material to SmoothPlastic and Transparency to 0.5. Got On = " .. Course.show(lamp:GetAttribute("On")) .. ", " .. tostring(lamp.Material) .. ", Transparency " .. lamp.Transparency)
	local okOn = Course.call(Builder.setLamp, lamp, true)
	Course.check("r5", okOn and lamp:GetAttribute("On") == true and lamp.Material == Enum.Material.Neon and lamp.Transparency == 0,
		"setLamp(lamp, true) should set On to true, the material to Neon and Transparency to 0.")
end)

Course.try("r6", function()
	local _, lamp = Course.call(Builder.makeLamp, Vector3.new(0, 0, -30), folder)
	if not isPart(lamp) then
		Course.fail("r6", "Not checked: makeLamp didn't return a Part.")
		return
	end
	local good, connection = Course.call(Builder.watchLamp, lamp)
	if not good or typeof(connection) ~= "RBXScriptConnection" then
		Course.fail("r6", "watchLamp should return the connection it made, but " .. (if good then "returned " .. Course.show(connection) else "errored: " .. tostring(connection)))
		return
	end
	lamp:SetAttribute("On", false)
	task.wait(0.3)
	Course.check("r6", lamp.Material == Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic and math.abs(lamp.Transparency - 0.5) < 0.01, "After watchLamp, setting the lamp's On attribute to false should switch it off by itself, but its material is still " .. tostring(lamp.Material))
	lamp:SetAttribute("On", true)
	task.wait(0.3)
	Course.check("r6", lamp.Material == Enum.Material.Neon, "Setting On back to true should switch the lamp back on.")
	connection:Disconnect()
	lamp:SetAttribute("On", false)
	task.wait(0.3)
	Course.check("r6", lamp.Material == Enum.Material.Neon, "After disconnecting the connection watchLamp returned, changing On should no longer change the lamp.")
end)

Course.try("r7", function()
	local lamps = {}
	for i, x in { -30, 4, 25, 60 } do
		local _, lamp = Course.call(Builder.makeLamp, Vector3.new(x, 0, 0), folder)
		lamps[i] = lamp
	end
	for _, case in { { Vector3.new(20, 0, 0), 3 }, { Vector3.new(-100, 5, 0), 1 }, { Vector3.new(5, 0, 40), 2 }, { Vector3.new(58, 0, -3), 4 } } do
		local good, nearest = Course.call(Builder.nearestLamp, lamps, case[1])
		Course.check("r7", good and nearest == lamps[case[2]], "nearestLamp for the point " .. Course.show(case[1]) .. " should return the lamp at x = " .. lamps[case[2]].Position.X .. ", but returned " .. (if good and isPart(nearest) then "the lamp at x = " .. nearest.Position.X else Course.show(nearest)))
	end
	local good, none = Course.call(Builder.nearestLamp, {}, Vector3.zero)
	Course.check("r7", good and none == nil, "nearestLamp with no lamps should return nil.")
end)

folder:Destroy()
steps: In the `Builder` tab, make a module table with these five functions, and return it at the end.

`makeLamp(position, parent)`: create a Part with `Instance.new`, named `Lamp`, `Anchored`, with a Size of 1, 6, 1. Stand it on `position`, so its centre is 3 studs above that point. Set its Material to Neon, give it an attribute `On` set to `true`, set its Parent to `parent` last, and return it.

`ringOfLamps(centre, radius, count, parent)`: make `count` lamps with makeLamp, spread evenly around a circle on the ground. Use `math.cos` and `math.sin` of each lamp's angle times the radius for its X and Z offsets. Return them in a list. A count of 0 gives `{}`.
`setLamp(lamp, on)`: sets the `On` attribute. When on: Neon and Transparency 0. When off: SmoothPlastic and Transparency 0.5.
`watchLamp(lamp)`: connect to the lamp's `On` attribute changing, so the lamp updates itself with setLamp whenever the attribute changes. Return the connection.
`nearestLamp(lamps, point)`: return the lamp closest to `point`, measuring with `(a - b).Magnitude`, or `nil` for an empty list.
